name: Cornstarch Blanc Mange
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Take one quart of sweet milk and put one pint upon the stove to heat
In the other pint mix four heaping tablespoonfuls of cornstarch and half a cupful of sugar
When the milk is hot, pour in the cold milk with the cornstarch and sugar thoroughly mixed in it
Stir altogether until there are no lumps and it is thick
Take from the stove and add the whites of three eggs beaten to a stiff froth

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take one quart of sweet milk and put one pint upon the stove to heat
2. In the other pint mix four heaping tablespoonfuls of cornstarch and half a cupful of sugar
3. When the milk is hot, pour in the cold milk with the cornstarch and sugar thoroughly mixed in it
4. Stir altogether until there are no lumps and it is thick
5. Flavor with lemon
6. Take from the stove and add the whites of three eggs beaten to a stiff froth
